projectDescription: A web-based calculator and reference tool for pipefitters, covering pipe offsets, cut lengths, rolling offsets, spool calculations, and ASME reference data.
keyFeatures: Simple and rolling offset calculators with live diagrams
Kick offset for parallel pipe runs (2–4 kicks)
Weld prep calculator with bevel angle and root gap
Area and volume calculator for pipe capacity
Pipe weight and thread engagement lookup tables
Offset multiplier tables for common fitting angles
Works in imperial fractions and metric units
publicApiSurface: Simple Offset Calculator — rise + angle → travel, run, cut length
Rolling Offset Calculator — rise + horizontal offset + angle → true offset, travel, run, cut length
Kick Offset Calculator — spread, angle, number of kicks → individual cut lengths
Miter Cut Calculator — angle + pipe diameter + pieces → cut angle per piece, mark distances
Spool Cut Calculator — CTC / CTE / ETE dimensions → cut lengths
Weld Prep Calculator — pipe schedule + diameter → root gap, bevel angle, land
Area / Volume Calculator — pipe size + schedule → cross-section area, capacity, weight
Pipe Dimensions Table — NPS lookup → OD, wall thickness, schedule data
Pipe Weights Table — schedule + size → weight per foot
Thread Engagement Table — pipe size → NPT engagement lengths
Multiplier Tables — fitting angle → offset multiplier
